title: WaveformCaptureRequest
description: Orchestrator -> hub, published on <root>/scada/wave/<zone>/<bank_id>/<hub_id>/request, QoS 1, on-demand capture trigger (06-service-profiles-and-power-quality.md S6.4b). The hub responds by publishing on the matching .../raw topic (pq_waveform_raw.schema.json).

expires_at.description: The hub ignores the request if it cannot capture and publish before this deadline.
